purpose: Verify software correctness, archive integrity, and RSI code-version lineage without reading private labels or making a protein-function performance claim.

hashBinding.note: The evaluation opening binds the raw tracked protocol file hash; this document intentionally has no self-referential canonicalHash field.

parameters.name: REPOSITORY_ROOT
parameters.description: Canonical top-level Git worktree for the candidate version.

parameters.name: CANDIDATE_HEAD
parameters.description: Full Git object ID of the candidate code version.

parameters.name: VERSION_DIFF_BASE
parameters.description: Full Git object ID used as the public code-diff baseline.

parameters.name: STATE_ROOT
parameters.description: Durable adaptive StateRoot path when an adaptive-development result is produced.

parameters.name: VERSION_REMOTE
parameters.description: Remote containing the immutable RSI tag namespace, normally origin.

preconditions: Run from REPOSITORY_ROOT with the candidate commit checked out.
Do not read evaluator-private bundles, gold labels, target identifiers, or protected outcomes during the preregistration checks.
Record command, exit code, stdout/stderr digest, toolchain version, candidate commit, and execution time in a durable public receipt.
Any not_applicable check must include an explicit reason in the receipt; a failed required or applicable check cannot be converted to not_applicable.

checks.passCondition: Exit code is zero and the test runner reports no failed, cancelled, or skipped-by-failure test.
Exit code is zero and unittest reports no failure or error.
Exit code is zero and output is empty.
checks.note: For the first prospective root, the receipt must declare a reviewed public baseline instead of silently omitting this check.

checks.applicability: required when an adaptive-development result is produced or references a StateRoot; otherwise explicit not_applicable
checks.passCondition: Exit code is zero, archive verification reports ok, and the receipt records the returned archiveSealHash and publicManifestHash.

checks.applicability: required after version registration and again after evaluation result and decision publication
checks.passCondition: Exit code is zero, output reports ok true, all local/remote RSI tag objects match, and no unexpected incomplete evaluation remains.

receiptRequirements.privacy: The public receipt must not contain private paths, target identifiers, GO labels, evaluator-private hashes, secrets, or raw protected outputs.

allowed: The exact candidate code passed the listed software checks.
An applicable adaptive StateRoot passed archive-only integrity verification.
The local and remote RSI version/event graph passed the implemented structural verifier.
forbidden: Any claim that protein-function prediction accuracy improved.
Any Fmax, AUPR, Smin, calibration, generalization, leaderboard, or population-level claim.
Any claim that an unsigned annotated tag or same-disk StateRoot is tamper-proof.
